kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاير (form VI)
# نَتَعَايَرُ (nataʕāyaru) /na.ta.ʕaː.ja.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
# نَتَعَايَرَ (nataʕāyara) /na.ta.ʕaː.ja.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
# نَتَعَايَرْ (nataʕāyar) /na.ta.ʕaː.jar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَايَرَ (taʕāyara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
